question: What is Runa?
answer: Runa is your personal, AI-powered running companion. It helps you log your runs, analyze your pace, track your streaks, and stay consistent with smart, actionable insights.

question: Do I need an account to use Runa?
answer: Yes. Creating an account keeps your running data secure and personalized, ensuring your training history stays safe and synced across your devices.

question: Is my data safe on Runa?
answer: Absolutely! Your data is securely stored in our cloud database (Convex DB) and linked to your personal account. Unlike local browser storage, your runs are protected even if you clear your browser history or switch devices.

question: What can I track with Runa?
answer: You can log all the essentials: your run distance, duration, average speed, and personal notes about how the run felt. Runa takes these details to generate beautiful analytics, heatmaps, and progress stats.

question: Can I edit or delete my runs?
answer: Yep! We all make typos. You can easily edit or delete any of your past runs from your History tab, and all your stats and charts will update instantly.

question: Does Runa support goals and streaks?
answer: It sure does. You can set weekly distance goals to push yourself, and our Dashboard will track your daily running streaks and display them on a cool activity heatmap to keep you motivated.

question: What are AI Insights?
answer: Think of AI Insights as your pocket running coach. Runa analyzes your recent performance trends and gives you personalized tips, alerts you if you're pushing too hard, and celebrates your wins with tailored feedback.

question: Can I see analytics and charts?
answer: Definitely! The Analytics page is packed with deep dives into your data. You'll find heatmaps, pace vs. distance trends, weekly goal comparisons, and monthly progress rings. You can filter the data and download your favorite charts as images to share!

question: How is my data backed up?
answer: Your data is automatically backed up and synced to the cloud in real-time. Since we migrated to Convex DB, you don't need to manually export or restore backup files—simply log in on any device to access all your runs.

question: Does Runa support cloud backup?
answer: Yes! Cloud backup is fully supported and enabled by default. Your running history is securely saved in our cloud database (Convex DB) in real-time, allowing you to access your runs seamlessly across all your devices.

question: Does Runa work on mobile devices?
answer: 100%. Runa is fully responsive and designed to feel just like a native app on your phone, complete with a convenient bottom navigation bar for easy access during your cool-downs.

question: How can I give feedback?
answer: We love hearing from users! You can share your thoughts, feature requests, or bug reports directly through the feedback section in the Settings tab. It really helps shape future updates.

question: Why is there no light mode?
answer: Right now, Runa rocks a sleek, dark aesthetic to look great and save battery. But don't worry—a proper Light Mode is actively in the works and will be rolling out soon!

question: What is Global Chat and how does it work?
answer: Global Chat is a live, real-time community space built into Runa where all users can talk to each other. Open it by tapping the chat bubble icon in the navbar. You can send messages, reply to any message by hovering it and clicking the reply arrow, and edit or delete your own messages anytime. The chat loads the latest 50 messages and fetches older ones as you scroll up. An orange dot on the icon means a new message is waiting — it disappears once you open the chat.
